sources.own_factual_extraction: Official local-government usage gives 扎日南木错 in the title and 扎日南木措 in the body. It expressly gives aliases 塔热错 and 特里纳木错, places the lake in 措勤县 near the county town, and reports a lake area of 998 km². Its length/width, hydrological and elevation figures are descriptive historical values rather than a boundary dataset.

sources.read_location: Research-news narrative after Figure 2; Figure 2 lower-left map and longitudinal section.
sources.own_factual_extraction: The institute reports its own research finding that overflow from northern 蔡几错 contributed to expansion of 扎日南木错 from 2017 onward. Its text distinguishes overflow-connected upstream and downstream lakes from physically merged lakes. Figure 2 shows 蔡几错 and 齐格错 north of the target, with 2000 and 2018 lake outlines, and labels the downstream waterbody 扎日南木错. The southern target lake is cropped from that figure, so this map only supports adjacency and hydrological scope.

sources.agency_or_publisher: Frontiers in Earth Science; authors Mingzhi Sun, Jinyun Guo, Jiajia Yuan, Xin Liu, Haihong Wang and Chengming Li; Shandong University of Science and Technology, Wuhan University and Chinese Academy of Surveying and Mapping

acquisition.timestamp_scope: Original response body read completed at retrieved_at_utc; body bytes and hash are for that response.

sources.read_location: Study Area section; Figure 1 right panel; Lake Area section and Figure 11.
sources.own_factual_extraction: Original research uses the English name Zhari Namco and reports alias Chi-jih. It gives a study-area span of 30°44′–31°05′N, 85°19′–85°54′E. Figure 1 depicts the full named lake separately from its much larger drainage basin. Whole-outline visual comparison against that figure supports the target’s broad western basin and southeast-curving arm as this lake. The article reports area growth from 961.3 km² in 1995 to 1046.3 km² in 2018; Figure 11 is a time-series chart, not another shoreline map.
